    r = c.getresponse(); raw = r.read(); hdr = dict(r.getheaders()); c.close()
    parsed = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    return r.status, hdr, parsed

def check(name, condition, got=None):
    if not condition: raise AssertionError((name, got))
    print('ok', name)

p, port = start()
try:
    s,h,j=req(port,'GET','/health'); check('health', (s,j)==(200,{'status':'ok'}),(s,h,j))
    s,h,j=req(port,'GET','/v1/keys'); check('empty keys',(s,j)==(200,{'keys':[]}),(s,h,j))
    check('missing',req(port,'GET','/v1/kv/missing')[0]==404)
    check('create',req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/a%20b', {'value': {'x':[1,True,None]}})[0]==201)
    check('replace',req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/a%20b', {'value': 2})[0]==200)
    check('get',req(port,'GET','/v1/kv/a%20b')[2] == {'key':'a b','value':2})
    check('create z',req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/z', {'value':'last'})[0]==201)
    check('create A',req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/A', {'value':'first'})[0]==201)
    check('sort',req(port,'GET','/v1/keys')[2] == {'keys':['A','a b','z']})
    check('delete present',req(port,'DELETE','/v1/kv/z')[0]==204)
    check('delete missing',req(port,'DELETE','/v1/kv/z')[0]==404)
    check('method',req(port,'POST','/health', {})[0]==405)
    check('unknown',req(port,'GET','/what')[0]==404)
    check('malformed',req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/x','{', {'Content-Type':'application/json'})[0]==400)
    check('shape',req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/x',[])[0]==400)
    check('missing value',req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/x', {'ttl_seconds':1})[0]==400)
    check('unknown field',req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/x', {'value':1,'extra':2})[0]==400)
    for ttl in [0,-1,True,float('inf'),float('nan'),'1']:
        check('bad ttl '+repr(ttl),req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/x', {'value':1,'ttl_seconds':ttl})[0]==400)
    for path in ['/v1/kv/','/v1/kv/a/b','/v1/kv/%2F','/v1/kv/%ZZ','/v1/kv/%FF']:
        check('bad key '+path,req(port,'PUT',path, {'value':1})[0] in (400,404))
    check('limit declared',req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/x','x', {'Content-Length':str(1024*1024+1),'Content-Type':'application/json'})[0]==413)
    check('ttl create',req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/short', {'value':'gone','ttl_seconds':0.2})[0]==201)
    time.sleep(.3)
    check('ttl get',req(port,'GET','/v1/kv/short')[0]==404)
    check('ttl list','short' not in req(port,'GET','/v1/keys')[2]['keys'])
finally:
    stop(p)

p2, port2 = start()
try:
    check('restart persisted',req(port2,'GET','/v1/kv/a%20b')[2] == {'key':'a b','value':2})
    check('restart expired absent',req(port2,'GET','/v1/kv/short')[0]==404)
finally:
    stop(p2)
